An equipment whose tag is on an element of a page (tag, machine, loop or valve name, also "A / B" and "A-D" lists) needs no row here. map = the element that draws it (page|key=value; key = mach, loop, valve, tag, name or sym), with a note when one symbol stands for more. Every other PASOK equipment has no own symbol yet: tests/lanes/qa/phase9-gate.cjs lists it. approved = the pages the user approved (only the user approves; COMMANDMENT 4).
